results.name: Batch commits exact editable fields and every real public index row together
All-row input validation and byte-stream limit reject without creating any partial notes
Real index-table lock causes four-second refusal and rolls back already-inserted batch notes
Modified intervals read canonical file timestamps, not fresh index/rebuild timestamps, in literal and live metadata
Content byte intervals use real UTF-8 file/note sizes; zero/bad/incompatible ranges are explicit
Folder exclusion applies before all server branches and metadata paging, preserving wildcard-named siblings
Actual fuzzy fallback cannot bypass canonical size/date/exclusion predicates
Literal public pages have deterministic disjoint fixed-index coverage, cap 200 and reject invalid offsets
Preview reads current bounded public text, not stale index snippets; binary/Private/trashed/excluded/missing cases stay safe
